categories.main_business_segments: Solus Advanced Materials operates primarily in two segments: the battery copper foil segment (including battery foil and copper foil) and the advanced materials segment (electronic materials). The battery foil segment focuses on development, manufacturing, and sales of battery foil and copper foil through overseas subsidiaries, serving electric vehicle batteries and electronic applications. The advanced materials segment develops, manufactures, and sells OLED materials and other functional new materials for display applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes proprietary technologies in producing high-end battery foils and copper foils, including electroplating processes requiring precise chemical management and thickness control. It has secured advanced manufacturing capabilities through acquisitions and R&D investments, particularly in high-frequency and low-loss copper foils for semiconductors and communication equipment. In OLED materials, it leverages molecular design, synthesis know-how, and formulation technologies to develop high-performance organic light-emitting materials, including unique blue dopants and host materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global electric vehicle battery manufacturers, semiconductor and PCB companies, and OLED panel manufacturers. The battery foil segment serves major EV battery makers and automotive OEMs primarily in Europe and North America. The copper foil products target industries such as AI semiconductors, smartphones, data centers, and aerospace. The advanced materials segment serves leading OLED panel makers globally, including customers in China, Japan, and Korea.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates production facilities in Hungary (battery foil), Luxembourg (copper foil), and South Korea (OLED materials). It serves markets primarily in Europe, North America, and Asia, with sales organizations in Korea, the US, and Hong Kong. It is the only battery foil manufacturer in Europe and is expanding production capacity in Canada to serve the North American market. The advanced materials segment has a manufacturing presence in China to support customers in the Greater China region.
categories.supply_chain_position: Solus Advanced Materials operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, manufacturing key materials such as battery copper foil and OLED materials that are essential inputs for battery cell makers, PCB manufacturers, and display panel producers. It sources raw materials like copper scrap and chemicals globally and supplies these advanced materials directly to component manufacturers and OEMs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D to enhance technology competitiveness in battery foil and electronic materials, focusing on high-end, high-value products such as high-frequency copper foils and advanced OLED materials. It operates dedicated research centers for battery foil and advanced materials, investing in new formulations and manufacturing processes. Strategic initiatives include capacity expansion in Europe and North America, diversification of product portfolios, and development of foldable display electronic materials through its subsidiary Solus I-Tech.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of battery foils, copper foils, and OLED materials. Sales are conducted mainly via direct transactions with customers, with payment terms typically in USD or T/T within 60 days. The company also uses agents for overseas sales in the advanced materials segment. It has established long-term supply contracts with key customers, especially in the battery foil segment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Solus Advanced Materials holds a leading position as the sole battery foil manufacturer in Europe and commands a significant global market share in high-frequency and low-loss copper foils, especially for 5G communication equipment. Its copper foil subsidiary, Circuit Foil Luxembourg, is a market leader in specialized copper foils. The company competes with other global battery foil and OLED material producers but differentiates itself through technology leadership, geographic presence, and customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately KRW 429.4 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 3% increase year-over-year. The battery foil segment accounted for about 74% of sales and showed 9% growth, while the advanced materials segment contributed 26%. Total assets increased by 17% to KRW 1.7 trillion, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion. Despite operating losses in the battery foil segment, the company is progressing toward profitability with capacity ramp-up and cost improvements.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Solus Advanced Materials offers differentiated value through its unique position as the only European battery foil producer, enabling local supply to mitigate logistics and quality risks for customers. Its advanced copper foil products feature high-frequency and low-loss characteristics critical for 5G and semiconductor applications. In OLED materials, proprietary molecular design and formulation expertise provide high-performance materials that meet stringent customer specifications. The company emphasizes stable supply, technological innovation, and customer diversification to sustain competitive advantage.
